findings.title: Unconditional call to custom ensure_loaded! will crash if fallbacks object is replaced
findings.body: `set_locale` calls `I18n.fallbacks.ensure_loaded!`. That method is only defined on the new `FallbackLocaleList` class added in `config/initializers/i18n.rb`. If `I18n.fallbacks` is not that exact object (for example if an environment file, plugin, or test setup installs Rails' normal `I18n::Locale::Fallbacks`), this before_filter will raise NoMethodError on every request. Guard with `respond_to?(:ensure_loaded!)` or provide the method on the standard fallbacks object.

findings.title: Only the current locale is loaded; fallback locales may be missing outside controllers
findings.body: The accelerator loads only `config.locale` before calling the uncached translate. With `I18n::Backend::Fallbacks` enabled, a lookup can fall back to `SiteSetting.default_locale` and `:en`, but those locale files are only loaded by `FallbackLocaleList#ensure_loaded!`, which is called only from `ApplicationController#set_locale`. In background jobs, mailers, rake tasks, or initializers, fallback locales may remain unloaded, so fallbacks can return translation-missing strings. Zero-argument translations are cached, so a missing result can also be cached. Load the fallback chain in the translation path or wherever the locale is set.

findings.title: Fallback list does not behave like a normal Hash
findings.body: `FallbackLocaleList` subclasses `Hash` but overrides `[]` without storing entries. Hash methods such as `fetch`, `each`, `keys`, `key?`, and `to_h` will see an empty hash rather than the computed fallback arrays. If I18n or a plugin uses any of those methods on `I18n.fallbacks`, fallbacks can silently fail. Use a dedicated object implementing the expected interface or populate the hash.

findings.title: Race in initialization of loaded-locales list
findings.body: `ensure_loaded!` initializes `@loaded_locales` with `||=` outside `LOAD_MUTEX`, while `load_locale` mutates the array inside the mutex. On first concurrent uses, threads can race and overwrite or duplicate the loaded-locales list, causing redundant locale loading. Initialize and check the list under the same mutex or use a thread-safe collection.

findings.title: No tests for fallback behavior
findings.body: The change introduces server-side locale fallbacks and alters lazy locale loading, but adds no automated coverage. Tests should cover falling back from a user locale to the site default and English, behavior when the default locale changes, and translation outside controller requests such as jobs or mailers.
